name: Hazuki Shizuku
source:
Age: Unknown

A game director who is also the director of Eagle Jump's next title. She is mature and proactive woman who has a strong interest in cute girls, hence why her department is entirely female. She owns a cat named Mozuku who strolls freely around the office.
